verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Rippling's global payroll product lets founders pay employees and contractors in many countries, auto-calculates and files payroll taxes, and applies local labor policies (rippling-docs-16,17,39,40,26), which supports an owned-entity global payroll model. However, none of the evidence explicitly documents an Employer-of-Record (EOR) service or entity-owning arrangement for hiring in countries where the founder has no legal entity. Missing for 10: explicit EOR product/service documentation, details on how compliance/liability is handled when Rippling itself is the legal employer, and independent confirmation of EOR country coverage.
